published.citation: Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 6250 +/- 220 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 288842 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
